what_happened: The independent Oracle review of the PM-1-RX research specification could not be performed. The oracle sub-agent (ses_f7211bc23ffeoyzWLP293mhCZf) errored immediately with: 'You have no credits remaining. Add credits to continue using the API at https://platform.openai.com/settings/organization/billing/.'
root_cause: OpenAI API account has no remaining credits. The oracle specialist is backed by an OpenAI model (gpt-5.6-luna); explorer/fixer/librarian lanes used other providers and completed successfully.
what_i_did_wrong: I selected the oracle as the verification mechanism for a high-stakes specification without first confirming provider credits were available. A pre-flight credit check would have either avoided the wasted dispatch or prompted a fallback verification plan before the spec was finalized.
impact: The specification (8 documents + 7 JSON schemas) was NOT independently reviewed. Verification was downgraded to an orchestrator self-review, which is weaker because it shares the author's blind spots. This is a residual uncertainty on the deliverable, not a defect in the deliverable itself.
mitigation_applied: Performed a targeted self-review against the 8 review axes (falsifiability, internal consistency, confounds, oracle validity, minimality/feasibility, task-class risk, schema coherence, escape hatches).

Fix 1: added required 'attribution' field (enum: none/representation_insufficiency/consumer_unreliability/oracle_defect/capability_floor) to schema/evaluation.schema.json — falsification.md section 10 requires attribution but the schema could not represent it.
Fix 2: added explicit generator-model confound control + a named-confounds subsection to experiment-001-design.md section 5.
residual_risk: Other issues the oracle would have caught remain unidentified. Recommend an independent review before implementation begins (the next task), once credits are restored or via a non-OpenAI reviewer.
